reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:46-48, isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin(...) and isTeamOwner(...) with && instead of ||, and since isTeamAdmin checks ADMIN or OWNER while isTeamOwner checks only OWNER (packages/lib/server/queries/teams/index.ts:264-293), the expression only passes for team owners. Consequently, team ADMINs who are neither the organizer nor an attendee hit the FORBIDDEN error at addGuests.handler.ts:54-56.
